Both the conviction and relational reads mark these two as decision-grade/authority-ranking rather than mere claims — the same settled move surfaces once in narrative form and once in structured recap form, which is the read this group holds.

Held in tension: the summary form (src-4) drops the licensing-cost half present in the narrative form (src-2), a narrowing this group surfaces without resolving.
